headline: Bournemouth favourites as Milan lose two attackers
summary: Bournemouth host AC Milan in the Europa League on Thursday, and the market makes them 47.7% favourites, the margin removed. The football reasons are there: Bournemouth have won both of their Europa League games and beat Sunderland 2-0 on Sunday, creating 4.4 expected goals. Milan won 4-0 away at Salzburg in this competition, but they travel without Goncalo Ramos and Samuel Chukwueze, both ruled out hours before kick-off according to Sky Italia. Milan's win chance has fallen from 29.1% to 26.6%. Favourites, never a certainty: a draw or a Milan win together is still the more likely outcome.
read: Bournemouth are the home favourites at 47.7% after winning both of their Europa League games, while Milan arrive with Ramos and Chukwueze ruled out and their own win chance drifting to 26.6%. The market expects an open game of about three goals and rates the home side roughly half a goal the better team.

facts.fact: Bournemouth are favourites to win at 47.7%.
facts.meaning: The market rates the home side the better team, but far from certain — a draw or a Milan win together is the more likely outcome.

facts.fact: Goncalo Ramos has been ruled out of the Bournemouth trip after calf discomfort in training.
facts.meaning: Milan's forward line is thinner on the eve of the match, cutting Amorim's options from the bench and from the start.

facts.fact: Samuel Chukwueze is also ruled out of the Bournemouth game with a problem in his left hip.
facts.meaning: A second attacking absence in the same bulletin leaves Milan short of wide options away from home.

facts.fact: Milan's win chance fell from 29.1% to 26.6% in the last day.
facts.meaning: Money and information moved toward the home side rather than the Italian giants.

facts.fact: Bournemouth beat Sunderland 2-0 at home on Sunday, their first league win of the season.
facts.meaning: Rose's side arrive off their best result of the campaign, and they did it without conceding a meaningful chance.

facts.fact: Bournemouth are without Antoine Scott, who has played 536 minutes this season with a goal and an assist.
facts.meaning: A regular starter missing from midfield, not a squad filler.

facts.fact: Bournemouth generated 4.4 expected goals in the Sunderland win.
facts.meaning: They are creating far more than they allow — the chance quality behind their run, not just the scorelines.

facts.fact: Milan won 4-0 away at Red Bull Salzburg in the Europa League.
facts.meaning: They are dangerous on the road in this competition, which is why the market cannot write them off even at under 27%.

sources.fact: Bournemouth boss Marco Rose has described the AC Milan tie as a "huge game" against six-time Champions League winners and Italian giants.
Junior Kroupi has returned to Bournemouth training but is ruled out of the AC Milan match, according to Bournemouth Echo.

Marco Rose gave an update on Junior Kroupi in his Bournemouth injury news ahead of the AC Milan clash, with a two-week timeframe expected for Scott to miss the Milan, Man United, Bournemouth and Leeds games.
Bournemouth beat Sunderland 2-0 at the Vitality Stadium to secure their first league win of the season and move out of the relegation zone.
Bournemouth registered 29 shots and an xG of 4.32 in their win over Sunderland, and now head into the Milan visit off a landmark victory.
Goalkeeper Di Gregorio, on loan from Juventus, has made just one Carabao Cup appearance since arriving, with Petrovic remaining Marco Rose's starter, per Gazzetta.
Goncalo Ramos has been ruled out of the Bournemouth match after calf discomfort in training, with further medical tests expected, per Sky Italia.
Samuel Chukwueze has also missed training because of a problem with his left hip and is ruled out of the Bournemouth clash.
